Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Windsurf, and more. See the table below for paths and documentation. Covering everything from autonomous test creation and fast execution to testing AI agents, chatbots and voice assistants. | | | [Crawlbase](https://crawlbase.com/?utm_source=awesome-agent-skills&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=voltagent_2026q3&utm_content=readme_listing) is web data infrastructure trusted by 70,000+ developers.
